title: Inside the vanishing Godna tattoo art of India’s Baiga Tribe
description: What happens to an art form when the only people who understand it stop passing it on?  Godna, the traditional tribal tattoo art of central India’s Baiga community, was almost lost – its meanings held in memory and skin, never written down.  In this episode of Village Vibe – India’s Podcast About All Things Rural, […] The post Inside the vanishing Godna tattoo art of India’s Baiga Tribe appeared first on Village Square.
